author: Komorebi P.

scope.system: eight-state two-generator learned linear operator workspace
scope.primary_question: Do the saved learned dynamics form a continuation-stable positive-ray D4 action, and are identity-loop defects transversely attracting?
known_before_freeze: Stable Quotient v0.2.0 depth accuracies and named-loop endpoint angles
the projective checkpoints retain nonzero hidden holonomy
the synthetic six-case causal-completion controls all pass
the preserved v0.2.0 quick smoke failed its single-band NumPy replay gate and showed that raw embedding anchors are off the recurrent semantic codebook
the v0.2.0 quick scientific endpoints were inspected before this adaptive revision

checkpoint_extraction.allowed_storage: contiguous or strided CPU float32 within validated bounds

new_audit.positive_ray_angle: acos(dot(unit_left, unit_right)); negative rays are distinct
new_audit.matched_nonidentity_control: toggle the final generator of each registered relation word
new_audit.cluster_bootstrap_unit: episode, after aggregating the three relations and all eight start states

registered_endpoints: continuation-equivalence survival curve for identity-loop versus no-loop rays
first suffix horizon that reveals each loop defect
positive-ray angle and decoder decision-cone margin after each repeated loop
projective tangent derivative singular values for identity loops
all 64 D4 Cayley products compared with canonical reductions
all 28 D4 element pairs checked for a behavioral separating witness
positive rescaling invariance under every registered suffix

execution.restricted_loader: all six checkpoints accepted and malicious globals rejected

Q0_finite_behavioral_quotient.criterion: registered continuation accuracy >= 0.99 and exactly one discrete prediction signature per semantic state

P1_positive_scale_gauge.criterion: registered-future prediction agreement is exactly 1.0 for every positive scale

P2_projective_path_flatness.criterion: repeat-16 identity loops have worst median oriented angle <= 0.01 rad and behavioral equivalence through H=8 >= 0.999

A1_finite_D4_cayley.criterion: all 64 products have current behavioral agreement >= 0.999 and continuation equivalence through H=4 >= 0.99

A2_action_separation.criterion: at least 0.99 of episode-level D4 element pairs possess a current-output separating witness

N1_normal_attraction.criterion: for every identity relation, the 95th percentile of one-loop top tangent gain is < 1.0

comparative_completion.criterion: projective-terminal repeat-16 H=8 survival exceeds raw-terminal gauge-fixed survival and has lower median oriented loop angle

claim_rules.finite_horizon_only: Passing behavioral suffix tests supports only the registered H, episodes, and checkpoints.
claim_rules.observability_proxy: Centered-logit tangent Gramians are local proxies, not exact nonlinear causal quotients.
claim_rules.normal_attraction: A failed N1 gate rules out a normally attracting certificate under this assay; a pass is local sampled evidence, not a global proof.
claim_rules.projective_replay: Normalizing a legacy checkpoint is a gauge-fixed replay, not its original trained architecture.
